svg.title: louis-agent.site: a visitor opens a page and asks

g.text: louis-agent.site: a visitor opens a page and asks
the HTML, its head and its sections
the page, readable before the script
open a session, then the message
the open door: sessions a day
the turn, the page in view

text.tspan: The page comes ready, the chat comes from the same host:
the page is HTML before any script runs, and the guide's answer streams over
the API behind its open door.
